assets.purpose: Controlled 16:9 Seedance reference trial for the video-first ledger reveal and hold-last-frame interaction handoff

prompt.positive: Image 1 fixes the exact broad Qinhuai waterside environment, moon position, cold blue night exposure and sparse warm window reflections. Create one restrained twelve-second cinematic shot from a locked low camera near the water. For the first two seconds the water is empty and physically calm. A historically plausible late-imperial Chinese side-sewn thread-bound blank ledger then rises gently from the dark water without magic particles, opens naturally to a clean unmarked spread, and settles above the lower-right water plane. When the ledger is open, the original stitched binding edge must sit on the central opening pivot with four readable exposed thread groups; both far outer page edges must remain plain and unstitched. It is not a western hardback codex and has no central glued spine. Real fibrous xuan paper, aged woven cloth cover, damp page-edge weight, subtle water displacement and moonlit reflections. End with the open blank pages stable for at least two seconds, leaving the lower-left title and controls safe area readable. No hands, no people, no lettering and no camera cut.
negative: text, calligraphy, pseudo-writing, player name, subtitles, logo or watermark
western codex, central glued spine, stitches on either far outer page edge, symmetric hardback binding or floating detached pages
magic portal, glowing runes, gold particles, purple fantasy light or explosive splash
people, hands, faces, modern skyline, tourism light show or palace spectacle
rapid camera move, jump cut, time lapse, deformed book, intersecting pages or changing stitch count
generated dialogue, music, sound effects or any embedded audio
